title: Szydagis tests alleged crash debris with neutron activation

tellings.quote: My colleague Matthew Shadalagus has been working on studying debris from alleged crashes.

plain: A physicist at the University at Albany named Matthew Szydagis has been studying pieces of debris said to come from crashes of unknown craft, testing them with neutron activation, a lab method that fires neutrons at a sample to find out what elements it contains. His colleague, the researcher Kevin Knuth, whom the episode presents as a NASA whistleblower, mentions this work in passing to Jesse Michels without going into results. If such material ever showed something unusual, it would be physical evidence rather than testimony.
